facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Guaranteed Capital: Yes for selected cohort / exact amount not public on page
facts_raw.Capital Disclosure Status: Verified — Capital Offered / Amount Not Publicly Disclosed
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early-stage mining/deep-tech solution aligned to exploration, processing, waste/water, mining redesign, novel materials or reduced-impact mining.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。

facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: Mining/decarbonisation deeptech with a credible industrial deployment pathway and readiness to work with Rio Tinto assets/facilities.
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: Generic climate SaaS with no mining use case; pre-technology concept with no path to validation.
